note: House rules for armour and spotting in FIRN's simulations. Inspired by World of Tanks: the values and the order of operations follow that game's client as it stood in November 2026 (update 2.4.1), read on 2026-11-10. They are FIRN's house rules, not a statement about the game today. For a question about the real game, check the current patch and pass the values in; anything given on the command line overrides this file. Edit freely.

house.label: house rules, inspired by World of Tanks as of November 2026
order: the raw impact angle decides an automatic ricochet, unless the shell overmatches the plate (calibre over 3 times its thickness)
normalisation then reduces the angle; a shell over twice the plate's thickness gets normalisation x 1.4 x calibre / (2 x plate)
penetration is rolled on a bell curve, one standard deviation a third of the spread, never outside the spread
penetration is flat to 50 m, falls in a straight line through its 500 m figure and keeps falling beyond; shaped charges and high explosive lose nothing with range
a shaped charge that meets a spaced screen loses the screen's thickness, then 5 percent of what is left for every 100 mm of air behind it
spotted at: view range - (view range - 50) x concealment, never beyond 445 m, always inside 50 m
